```{r}
library(httr2)

resp <- request("https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/resource/rvmt-pkmq.json") |>
  req_url_query(
    `$select` = "count(*) AS n",
    `$where` = "crashdate >= '2026-07-01T00:00:00' AND crashdate < '2026-08-01T00:00:00'"
  ) |>
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()

as.integer(resp[[1]]$n)
```
```{r}
library(httr2)

req = request("https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/resource/rvmt-pkmq.json") |>
  req_url_query(
    `$select` = "count(distinct instanceid) AS n",
    `$where` = "crashdate >= '2026-07-01T00:00:00' AND crashdate < '2026-08-01T00:00:00'"
  )

resp = req_perform(req) |> resp_body_json()

as.integer(resp[[1]]$n)
```


```{r}
base = "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"
starts = seq(from = 1, to = 351, by = 50)
pages = vector("list", length(starts)) # initializing the list (similar to initializing the df)

for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(paste0(base, "/registry?start=", starts[i]))
  pages[[i]] = data.frame(
    class = pg |> 
      rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span") |> # corresponds to the first row (telling us the class), you can copy the path like this or use `.ship-class`
      rvest::html_text2(),
    value = pg |> 
      rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(3) > span") |> # corresponds to the third row (telling us the est. salvage), you can copy the path like this or use `.salvage-value`
      rvest::html_text2() |> 
      readr::parse_number()
  )
  Sys.sleep(1)   # robots.txt asks for it
}
registry = dplyr::bind_rows(pages)   # 400 rows?

dreadnought_df = registry |> 
  dplyr::filter(class=="Dreadnought")

sum(dreadnought_df$value)
```

```{r}
base = "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"

starts = seq(from = 1, to = 321, by = 40)

classes = c()

for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(
    paste0(base, "/exam/registry?start=", starts[i])
  )

  classes = c(classes,
    pg |>
      rvest::html_elements(".ship-class") |>
      rvest::html_text2()
  )

  Sys.sleep(1)
}

length(classes)

sum(classes == "Dreadnought")
```

```{r}
library(ellmer)

# 1. Create a chat object
chat <- ellmer::chat_openai()

# 2. Define the Airbnb listing description
description <- "This one of a kind, turn of the century, fully restored mansion is just waiting for you to come and enjoy the vast amenities this house offers! This historic Victorian Mansion was built in the last 1800's and has been fully restored and updated with one thing in mind--luxury! We boast a slate pool table, 10 person hot tub, a custom made fire table, a built in giant projector screen for streaming, arcade games, and much much more! We comfortably sleep 19 guests with 9 dedicated bedrooms."

# 3. Define the structured output schema
schema <- ellmer::type_object(
  property_type = ellmer::type_string(),
  max_guests = ellmer::type_integer(),
  num_bedrooms = ellmer::type_integer(),
  key_amenities = ellmer::type_string(
    "List key amenities separated by |"
  )
)

# 4. Extract structured information
result <- chat$chat_structured(
  description,
  type = schema
)

# 5. Display results
print(result)
```

```{r}
nzchar(Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
```

```{r}
library(ellmer)

chat = ellmer::chat_openai(
  model = "gpt-5.6-luna"
)

schema = ellmer::type_object(
  property_type = ellmer::type_string(),
  max_guests = ellmer::type_integer(),
  num_bedrooms = ellmer::type_integer(),
  key_amenities = ellmer::type_string(
    description = "List key amenities separated by |"
  )
)

result = chat$chat_structured(
  description,
  type = schema
)

print(result)
```
